stem: Which of the following statement about transplantation in relapsed MM is wrong?

options.A: In transplantation‐eligible patients relapsing after primary therapy that did NOT include an autologous HCT, high‐dose therapy with autologous HCT as part of salvage therapy should be considered standard
options.B: A rescue or salvage auto‐HSCT could be tried when the response duration to the first transplant in less than 6 months
options.C: Allogeneic HCT should be considered appropriate therapy for any eligible patient with early relapse (less than 24 months) after primary therapy that included an autologous HCT or with high‐risk features.
options.D: If the rescue auto‐HSCT is performed, post transplant maintenance should be considered.
options.E: Clinical trials in patients with relapsed MM have demonstrated that more intense therapy (triplets versus doublets) is associated with improvements in depth of response, and that depth of response is associated with improvements in PFS

stem: Which of the following statement about transplantation in severe aplastic anemia is wrong?

options.A: In patients older than 40 years, and for patients without a matched sibling donor, antithymocyte globulin + cyclosporine A + eltrombopeg should be the first‐line therapy
options.B: If an HLA‐matched family donor is identified, bone marrow transplantation should be the first‐line therapy in patients younger than 40 years.
options.C: The standard conditioning regimen for matched sibling transplants is cyclophosphamide 200 mg/kg (CY 200) and ATG(antithymocyte globulin).
options.D: Peripheral blood has been shown to be superior to bone marrow, as a stem cell source, in matched sibling transplants because of less acute and chronic GVHD
options.E: Patients with SAA undergoing alternative donor transplants, especially with an ATG‐based regimen, are at high risk of developing EBV‐related lymphoproliferative disorders.

ebmt_chapters: Ch78 Acquired Bone Marrow Failure: Severe Aplastic Anemia and Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria (PDF p695–703)

stem: 下列有關 CAR-T (Chimeric antigen receptor T-cells) 治療後的併發症處理與長期追蹤的敘述，下列何者為正確的敘述？

options.A: 在接受lymphodepleting chemotherapy 後給予routine G‐CSF 以預防neutropenia，已被證明是安全有效的處理方式
options.B: Secondary haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (sHLH) 是 CAR‐T 治療後罕見的併發症，但一般來說經過適當的支持治療均可緩解。
options.C: 臨床試驗已經證明，在CAR‐T 治療後發生 Long‐term B‐cell aplasia 且 IgG level 長期低下的情形，給予IVIG 補充至physiological level 可以降低發生嚴重感染的機會。

stem:
Which of the following statement(s) is(are) the feature(s) of immune reconstitution following hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT)?
(1) Plasma cells/dendritic cells decrease less after conditioning chemotherapy
(2) CD4+ cells/NKT cells recovered in few weeks after HSCT
(3) Deficiencies of B‐cell and T‐cell reconstitutation are associated with decreased responses to vaccines and the development of secondary malignancy
(4) In the patients with chronic myelogenous leukemia, T‐cell depletion HSCT is associated with a decreased risk of relapse

stem:
Which of the following statements about HLA matching in unrelated donors is/are correct?
(1) The outcomes of transplantation with MSD and with HLA‐matched MUD are comparable.
(2) Disparities in HLA‐DQB1 have been reported to be permissive with no negative effects on outcomes.
(3) Nonpermissive mismatches in DPB1 are associated with poorer outcome compared to full matches.
(4) The more disparities in donor‐recipient HLA‐A, B, C, and DRB1 matching status, the poorer the survival outcome would be.

stem:
Choose the correct statement(s) for post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy):
(1) PTCy eliminates alloreactive T‐cell clones of both donor and host origin in the early posttransplantation period.
(2) PTCy also eliminates regulatory T cells.
(3) PTCy is usually administrated on day+3 and +4 after alloHSCT.
(4) PTCy is only indicated in haploidentical allotransplant setting but not in matched siblings or unrelated allotransplants.

Choose the correct statement(s) for HSC cryopreservation:
(1) Cryopreservation within 48h or less is recommended following collection to maintain an optimal viability.
(2) The final product includes 15‐20% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) as a cryoprotectant.
(3) The maximum nuclear cell concentration in the cryostored transplant should be ≤ 4 x 108/mL.
(4) Freezing at a controlled rate of 2‐5℃ per minute is recommended.

stem:
Which one is risk factors for acute GVHD have been identified?
(1) Degree of HLA disparity (unrelated donor or HLA‐mismatched donor).
(2) Stem cell source (higher risk of acute GVHD with peripheral blood and bone marrow graft versus umbilical cord blood).
(3) Donor and recipient sex disparity (female donor to male patient).
(4) Higher intensity of alloHCT conditioning regimen.
